verdict.rationale: Dropbox has a broad official API: the Files API covers creating, reading, editing, moving and deleting files and folders, and the platform also exposes sharing, previews, search, webhooks, team namespace listing, scoped OAuth and multiple official SDKs. Separately, Dropbox Sign offers an eSignature API. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do, and several UI features have no evidenced API equivalent. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, API coverage for Dash AI search/summarization, PDF editing, password-protected files and deleted-file restore, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), independent corroboration of coverage breadth.
